summary: Assess forecasting, storage dispatch, demand response, and grid constraints. Explore the five-day practical course and curriculum.
lede: Grid flexibility training helps power-system planners, operators, regulators, developers, and advisers assess how variable renewable generation affects system operations. Participants analyse net-load profiles and forecast error, compare dispatch, storage, and demand-response options, and examine transmission constraints. Spreadsheet-based exercises support an options assessment and action plan, while AI-assisted forecasting and advanced dispatch modeling are introduced conceptually, without coding or production system configuration.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, operate, regulate, develop, or advise on power systems integrating variable renewable generation.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of electricity systems, utility operations, or renewable energy project development is recommended. No coding is required. Advanced forecasting and dispatch optimization are covered at conceptual and operational interpretation levels; exercises use simplified spreadsheet calculations.
